title: Hitler regime support for Zionist revolutionary groups

tellings.quote: the the Hitler regime did lend support to the uh at that time the sort of Zionist movement to

plain: Matthew Brown, who is presented on the show as a Pentagon whistleblower, says that in the 1930s and 1940s Hitler's government lent support to what he calls "the sort of Zionist movement" of the time, the movement to found a Jewish state in Palestine, which Britain then ruled. He says it in passing and names no source. If true, it would mean the Nazi state backed groups that seem like its natural enemies.
